title: 10-Day Athens, Mykonos, Santorini & Cairo Tour
metaDescription: Combine Athens, Mykonos and Santorini with Cairo in 10 days, blending Cycladic island scenery with the Acropolis, Pyramids and ancient Egyptian heritage.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour pairs Athens and two Cycladic islands with a focused stay in Cairo. Begin in Athens before traveling by ferry to Mykonos and Santorini, with time on each island rather than treating them as brief cruise stops. The journey then shifts to Egypt by air, where Cairo provides the archaeological finale with the Pyramids of Giza and other scheduled historical visits.
The escorted itinerary operates from April to October and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, guided-tour entrance fees, airport transfers, one domestic flight and Greek ferry tickets. The program keeps the Egypt portion centered on Cairo rather than extending to a Nile cruise or Upper Egypt.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the National Library. Visit the Presidential Mansion to watch the Evzones Guards, then continue to the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out and transfer to the port for the Seajets ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel. Rest of the day is free at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.
Domestic flights to Mykonos are also available upon request.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Mykonos and the charming streets of Mykonos Town. Relax on the beaches, enjoy local cafés and shops, or experience the island’s lively atmosphere and nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorini by Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out and transfer to the port according to your ferry time for departure to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Santorini
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Full day free at leisure in Santorini to relax on the island’s beautiful beaches or explore the charming town of Fira. Optional boat and bus tours are available to visit the volcano and ancient ruins. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Cairo via Athens By flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out and transfer to Santorini International Airport for the flight to Cairo.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to the hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Visit Egyptian Museum and Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the famous Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali, also known as the Alabaster Mosque. Continue to Old Cairo to visit Church of Saints Sergius and Bacchus and the famous The Hanging Church. Later, explore the lively Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Giza Sightseeing - Visit Pyramids and Sphinx
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Meet your guide in the hotel lobby and begin the sightseeing tour. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Check out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour covers Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini in Greece, along with Cairo in Egypt. This itinerary combines the beauty of the Greek Islands with the ancient wonders of Egypt, offering travelers a perfect blend of history, culture, island charm, and iconic landmarks. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,575 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. Additional transportation between destinations is provided according to the tour program. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Greece and Egypt. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and excellent locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Egypt. Your guides will provide valuable insights into the history, culture, archaeology, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines Greece's most famous islands with Egypt's legendary capital city, offering an excellent introduction to two of the Mediterranean region's most popular destinations.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historical sites, archaeological attractions, museums, island towns, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis and historic landmarks of Athens, the cosmopolitan atmosphere and beautiful beaches of Mykonos, the stunning caldera views and whitewashed villages of Santorini, and the Pyramids of Giza, Great Sphinx, and Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 10-Day Greece & Egypt Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Luxor, Aswan, Alexandria, Crete, or additional Greek islands, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
